name: find_files
description: find_files must locate a file by name from anywhere under the root — the question list_files and search_code cannot answer. The name asserted is build.zig.zon, which the build itself depends on, so it exists in every checkout that compiles; the assertion is the shape of the answer (found, count >= 1), not any particular path list, so adding another matching file elsewhere cannot break it.
prompt: Use the find_files tool with pattern "build.zig.zon". Look at the tool's JSON result. Reply with exactly FOUND if its ok field is true and its count field is at least 1; otherwise reply with exactly MISSING.
